Emma (Support): Heads-up — ACME reported that their org's monthly credits dropped to 0 for ~7 minutes during the scheduled refill window (region: eu-west-1). They saw a partial refill, then the UI showed 0 again. Ticket CS-4572.

Ryan (SRE): Ack. Can you paste tenant/org id and a few affected request IDs? Also which timezone their account uses?

Emma (Support): tenant_id=acme-927; org_id=org_8271; account_tz=CET. Example request id from their client: req_3a9f7bce. They said refill time ~2026-03-01T00:00:05+01:00. Logs:
```
2026-03-01T00:00:04Z REFILL_JOB started for org_8271 run_id=run-3250001100
2026-03-01T00:00:04Z REFILL_JOB success: allocated 120000 tokens
2026-03-01T00:00:08Z CACHE_UPDATE tenant=org_8271 keys=credits-ui ttl=0
2026-03-01T00:00:09Z UI_READ tenant=org_8271 returned=0 (cache)
```

Nishant (Backend): That "CACHE_UPDATE ... ttl=0" looks suspicious. Which cache layer is that — edge cache or the display cache? Also did we see any memcache evictions around that time?

Ryan (SRE): I pulled memcache stats — a spike in evictions at 2026-03-01T00:00:07Z for the eu-west cluster. Refill job correctly wrote to the authoritative billing store, but the UI read path used the display cache which was evicted and then returned default=0 until the display cache refresh completed. OpsBot shows the refill job finished: run-3250001100.

OpsBot: refill-scheduler: job run-3250001100 completed for org_8271 (status: success) at 2026-03-01T00:00:04Z :white_check_mark:

Emma (Support): Customer impact: short window where UI showed zero and some client-side requests were throttled because they saw a 0 credit bucket. They hit 429s for ~6 minutes. They want explanation + mitigation.

Nishant (Backend): Immediate mitigation: invalidate display cache keys for org_8271 and trigger a refresh. I can run a one-off flush. Longer term: refresh-after-write or read-through for the display cache so it's consistent with refill writes. Also add a guard so display cache never returns zero while refill job is in-flight (or return stale value).

Ryan (SRE): Running a targeted cache invalidate now: `cachectl flush-key --cluster=eu-west --key=credits-ui:org_8271` — flushed at 2026-03-01T00:03:21Z.

Emma (Support): Customer confirmed UI is back to normal at 00:03:55 CET and 429s stopped. :tada:

Liz (CSM): I'll send a post-incident note to ACME explaining what happened and the planned fix timeline. Also offer a small credit for the disruption.

Ryan (SRE): Action items:
- Nishant: implement read-through or write-through fix for display cache (priority P2)
- Platform: add metric for cache eviction spikes during refill windows (P3)
- Support: escalate refunds if customer requests.

Emma (Support): Thanks — will update ticket CS-4572 and follow up with ACME. :thumbsup:
